newsitem.title: USA: Campbell Soup introduces new soup carton.
newsitem.headline: Campbell Soup introduces new soup carton.

text.p: Campbell Soup Co said on Thursday it introduced Swanson Chicken Broth in a new 32-ounce resealable carton, because research showed most recipes involving broth needed either more or less than the traditional can size.
The company said the new package joined the Swanson broth line, which included 14.5-ounce and 49-ounce cans, in chicken, beef, vegetable and reduced sodium chicken varieties.

The new product, which is 99 percent fat-free, would be available this month at a suggested retail price of $1.99, Campbell said, adding that the ready-to-serve broth category had sales in 1996 of about $200 million.
The new package featured the traditional aqua-blue Swanson logo and would be supported by television advertising and consumer promotions, the company said.
